scope: Three-case repaired rule-ID planning and flat evidence annotation using the same frozen inputs. Inherit the first pilot consumption; no quota reset, searches, fetches or forecasts. Repaired regressions, not unseen validation.

manual_quality_review.conclusion: Rule-ID and flat-output interface now reaches evidence annotation on all three repaired cases; semantic correctness and generalization are not established.

findings.assessment: One material-backed entity observation, one unsupported interval claim and one explicit missing threshold.

issues.detail: An August 3 directive with no rescission text cannot establish that no rescission occurred through September 1. The reviewer copies the target date as its observation and infers absence from silence.

The rule already defines the 50 MW threshold. The acquisition need should concern applicability to qualifying facilities, not request an external redefinition of a rule constant. A directive applying to all data centres may require scope reasoning rather than a literal 50 MW mention.

findings.positive: A threshold-related uncertainty is retained for downstream review rather than silently assumed.

findings.assessment: Official source identified; user-count, institutional-count/duration and ransom qualification gaps preserved.

issues.detail: All three event paths are called critical independently. No explicit OR group is represented. The after-question-opening qualification and exclusion of attacker-only claims are not explicit in the generated plan.

findings.positive: The reviewer does not invent the 10,000-user count, 100-institution/four-hour threshold or ransom demand.

findings.assessment: The September prices are correctly identified as outside the June-to-August observation window.

issues.detail: The reviewer cites a market-data passage but sources USD0.25 from the question rules rather than that material.
The source reason calls the data Adjusted Close although saved records are labelled close. The schema has not validated adjustment provenance.

findings.positive: All four requested in-window price/date needs remain explicitly uncovered; source and ticker are preserved as background.

general_design_limits: Rule IDs guarantee literal rule identity, not complete or correct requirement extraction.
An atomic target dimension can be narrower than its compound condition. Complete observation of one dimension must not establish the whole condition.
An observation needs an explicit provenance distinction between saved material, question-defined constants and inference.
Absence across an interval requires coverage evidence; silence in one document is not a complete negative witness.
Separate rule-defined constants from facts to acquire; a missing literal restatement of a rule constant is not necessarily a real material gap.
manual_quality_review.production_adoption: not supported by this repaired three-case trial
manual_quality_review.next_validation: Freeze these interface cases as regressions. Design general observation provenance and condition-coverage checks before broader unseen validation; avoid question-specific phrase rules.
